output.summary: The 98% on-time figure is an artifact of promised-date revisions. Network revisions rose from about 2.8 to 14.1 per 100 shipments in March 2026, and Northgate and Riverside jumped as the bonus took effect on 1 March. Pell Junction jumped in July, when its bonus eligibility began. Customer-requested revisions were flat (1.6 vs 1.8), so the rise is not customer-driven. Brightwell's receiving logs show 81% on time against 87% a year earlier, and 311 of its shipments were revised while it requested only 46. RouteWise and the portal do not explain the trends. Driver vacancy is a possible contributor but is confounded. Do not run the campaign or raise the bonus. Recompute on-time against the original date first.
